procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session, with no spawned, forked or resumed critic and no peer or producer records inspected. Verified the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules, method/addendum/helper bytes and all five manifests and fifteen poster byte pins. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty: no source opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Read all five exact pinned native-evidence manifests before the poster opens, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Used functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail:'original') and image(...,'original') to actually display and inspect M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen opens completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Recorded all fifty first readings afterward in packet copy order. A single genuine glyph uncertainty on M1 copy index 7 prompted one additional open of that exact pinned native image; the first reading remains unchanged and the revisit is retained. No other repeat open, substitute view, crop, resampling, OCR, image generation or editing was used. Actual native dimensions are 1672x941 for M1/M2/M3/M5 and 1672x940 for M4. All pass the pinned 16:9 nearest-integer-single-edge rule through abs(height-1672*9/16)=0.5; none is mathematically exact. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, respecting width/long-edge limits and aspect rounding. Receipts attest actual semantic inspection; they do not claim a serialized tool-event identity or runtime session ID.
